noise_corpus_manifest.full_name: DEMAND: a collection of multi-channel recordings of acoustic noise in diverse environments
noise_corpus_manifest.authors: Joachim Thiemann, Nobutaka Ito, Emmanuel Vincent
noise_corpus_manifest.redistribution: Permitted with attribution under CC BY 4.0. Attribution is carried in this manifest and in the dataset README.
noise_corpus_manifest.citation: J. Thiemann, N. Ito, E. Vincent, 'DEMAND: a collection of multi-channel recordings of acoustic noise in diverse environments', Proc. Meetings on Acoustics (ICA 2013), doi:10.5281/zenodo.1227121.
preprocessing: Downloaded the official 16 kHz release zips (PSTATION_16k.zip, DKITCHEN_16k.zip, PCAFETER_16k.zip) from Zenodo record 1227121.
NO resampling was applied by us: the 16 kHz release is the authors' own downsample of the 48 kHz masters, so the benchmark rate is met without adding a resampling stage of our own.
Kept channel ch01 only from each 16-channel array recording; ch02-ch16 dropped (same room, same 5 minutes, highly correlated - they add size, not variety).
Bytes are the unmodified wav members of the official zips: no gain change, no filtering, no trimming, no format conversion. sha256 of each extracted file is recorded above.

notes: ASR runs with vad_filter=False so the measured damage is the noise, not faster-whisper's internal VAD; clean WER here is therefore not identical to the vad_filter=True numbers in Results/kaggle_t4.
SNR is referenced to the RMS of the speech-active region, not the whole file, so leading/trailing silence does not shift the level.
Denoiser enhancement is reported as SI-SDR improvement measured in this run; the +10.4 dB in prototype/EDGE_UPGRADES.md is NOT reused.

experiment_n3_vad_false_trigger.definition: Fraction of noise-only segments (no target speech present) on which SileroVAD.is_speech returns True. Every such trigger costs a full ASR pass on nothing.
experiment_n3_vad_false_trigger.caveat_for_corpus_cells: 'False' trigger is only well defined for the synthetic cells and for recorded environments with no talkers. DEMAND PCAFETER is real multi-talker babble and DKITCHEN/PSTATION contain intermittent real speech, so a trigger there is the VAD doing its job on somebody else's voice, not an error. Read those rows as 'how often this environment opens the gate', and do not pool them with the synthetic false-trigger rate.

demand.caveat: REAL RECORDED NOISE from the DEMAND corpus (Thiemann, Ito & Vincent 2013, doi:10.5281/zenodo.1227121, CC BY 4.0), official 16 kHz release, channel ch01, segment drawn at a seed-determined offset. This satisfies the DEMAND half of CLAUDE.md section 4. MUSAN is still NOT included - there is no official MUSAN subset, only an 11 GB tarball - so no MUSAN claim may be made from this run.

synthetic.caveat: SYNTHETIC NOISE, NOT DEMAND/MUSAN. The noise in this cell is generated deterministically from a seed, not recorded. Results are valid for relative comparison within this run only and are NOT comparable to published numbers on DEMAND or MUSAN. Run with noise_source='corpus' for the real-corpus (DEMAND) condition.

headline.interpretation: A positive wer_delta means GTCRN made the transcript WORSE than the raw noisy audio. Perceptual enhancement (SI-SDR up) and ASR accuracy can move in opposite directions; if they do here, the deployment decision follows WER, not SI-SDR.
